answer: Sybil resistance via bonding: every agent posts a stake before acting, and honest work builds reputation like a reef growing layer by layer. Newcomers enter on a lower terrace with smaller caps until peers attest their output; forged identities must stake each time but earn nothing while rejected. A pearl of verified work — attested, on-ledger — becomes the only currency of standing, so flooding the network with cheap aliases yields no payoff.
